This website is generated with Quarto and hosted on GitHub Pages. Project metadata live in data/projects.csv, while detailed content lives in Markdown files.

text:

Edit data/projects.csv to update searchable metadata.
Edit project Markdown files inside projects/projectXX/.
Render the website:

quarto render

Commit and push:

git add .
git commit -m "Update project website"
git push
